titre: Nouvelles capacités de gazoducs prévues aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Milliards de pieds cubes par jour, mises en service prévues sur 2026 et 2027, total et trois premiers États d'origine

États-Unis, total.texte: approximately 44.9 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of new pipeline capacity online in the United States in 2026 and 2027

Texas.texte: More than 66% (29.7 Bcf/d) of the capacity additions originate in Texas.

Louisiane.texte: Louisiana is second with 19% (8.4 Bcf/d) of total capacity additions.

Virginie.texte: Virginia has the third most capacity additions over the next two years, with 1.6 Bcf/d expected to come online in 2027
